descriptors.concept_name: Professional Behaviour and Conceptual Framework Application
descriptors.definition: Chartered Accountants must maintain honesty and avoid bringing the profession into disrepute through exaggerated claims or improper advertising. Practitioners apply a conceptual framework by identifying, evaluating, and addressing threats to fundamental ethical principles using professional judgment and the reasonable and informed third party test.
inclusion: Prohibiting exaggerated claims about qualifications or services
Applying the conceptual framework to identify and evaluate threats
Exercising professional judgment in professional activities
exclusion: Making unsubstantiated comparisons to the work of others
Violating council advertisement guidelines directly or indirectly
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from technical audit procedures by its primary focus on ethical compliance and professional deportment.
source_ambiguities: The source text abruptly truncates at the end of the excerpt during the discussion of professional judgment.
